promotion_rules: Key a line by namespace, catalogue reference, primary side code and primary line code; key an occurrence additionally by zero-based token position.
Collapse repeated concordance observations of the same line only when transcriptions agree; collect all source locators. Conflicts are review items, never overwrite choices.
Identical strings on different lines or references remain distinct records; catalogue references do not by themselves prove independent physical artifacts.
Maintain a reviewed diplomatic tier preserving LOSS, UNKNOWN and *doubt and a fully identified undoubted tier requiring validated IDs, no loss/unknown/doubt and documented whole-line review.
Do not infer side, line or ancient direction from digital sequence order, source_doc_count, candidate direction, or normalized RTL layout.

Compare exports by exact uncertainty-aware normalized tokens. Report equal string observed, definite mismatch, or uncertainty prevents exact comparison. String equality alone does not locate the export among multiple identical lines.
An unmatched line is missing as a complete exported string, not necessarily new sign occurrences: substring overlap or a different selected line must be reported separately.
Do not join across LOSS or UNKNOWN when computing adjacency. Local verified segments can support explicitly partial analyses; doubtful identities require exclusion or separate sensitivity analyses.
